one_liner: An append-only, tamper-evident log of real agent actions with real tx hashes — plus a wallet-activity reporter with Markdown, CSV, and PDF exports.
what_it_does: This lamp keeps a log of agent actions where every entry links to the previous one, so any tampering breaks the chain and is detectable. It also turns a wallet plus a date range into a readable activity report. Proven by 2 real on-chain dust transactions and 15 verified log entries on the Atlantic testnet, all linked below.
